extension.summary: Multi-Provider WireGuard VPN Manager (NordVPN, PIA, Custom, ProtonVPN)
extension.description: High-performance, hardened WireGuard VPN manager for LibreELEC. Supports multiple providers including NordVPN (NordLynx), Private Internet Access (PIA), ProtonVPN via Custom Mode, and Custom configurations. Features an automated Systemd watchdog to prevent connection drops.[CR][CR][B]Note:[/B] Designed specifically for LibreELEC. [CR][CR][B]Features:[/B][CR]• Multi-Provider Support (Nord, PIA, Custom)[CR]• Pure Python WireGuard Handshake logic[CR]• Smart Watchdog & Auto-Reconnect[CR]• Hardened DNS & IPv6 Leak Protection[CR][CR][B]Disclaimer:[/B] Not an official product of any VPN provider. Use at your own risk.
extension.news: [B]v1.5.2 (2026-08-03)[/B] - Fixed: Resolved an exit status 22 argument error on Wi-Fi profile swaps - Fixed: Prevented system lockouts and file tracking freezes on slower hardware tiers - Optimized: Maintained local subnets and gateway paths to guarantee uninterrupted SSH/Samba access - Fixed: Resolved an exception routing conflict where upstream HTTP 429 server blocks returned empty token responses - Fixed: Resolved an issue causing the exception tree to misinterpret events and erroneously trigger the 401 alert window - Optimized: Implemented dynamic file state inspection within the token verification routine to accurately isolate locks - Optimized: Prioritized system rate-limiting locks over authentication validation screens during active profile swaps - Fixed: Resolved a critical ConnMan file descriptor leak causing system instability and orphaned CLOSE_WAIT TCP sockets during interface state changes - Optimized: Implemented direct, transactional runtime synchronization of /etc/resolv.conf to bypass OS DNS proxy fallbacks - Fixed: Resolved geographical Anycast routing mismatches and DNS leak false-positives to guarantee uninterrupted access to geo-blocked streams - Optimized: Engineered a dynamic dual-stack DNS fallback routine restoring custom privacy upstreams and IPv6 structural paths upon tunnel disengagement - Fixed: Restructured firewall iptables rule execution hierarchy to ensure legitimate tunnel DNS handshakes execute cleanly above interface drop policies
